hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bun run --bun oxfmt --write "$f"; }
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && bun run lint:fix && bun run format && bun run test -- --reporter=agent || exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Running Oxlint lint/type checks and fixes, Oxfmt, and tests...
